messages:
Sarah L.: Thanks everyone for the all-hands — quick follow-ups on the security roadmap items. TL;DR: questions about SOC2/ISO timelines, VPC private control plane availability, BYOK/KMS, audit log routing & retention, and evidence requests.

Ajay P.: Great questions. Quick answers: SOC2 Type II audit kickoff targeted for 2025-07 (report by Q4). ISO 27001 assessment running in parallel, target certificate by Q4 2025. VPC private control plane (self-hosted management plane) alpha for select partners in Sept 2025, GA early 2026. BYOK/KMS: BYOK for customer data in transit/at-rest is on the roadmap; HSM-backed BYOK for Private will be a later milestone — we're engaging HSM vendors now and drafting integration patterns.

Maria G.: On audit logs — we'll support streaming to customer S3 buckets and to common SIEMs (Splunk, Datadog) with per-org retention controls. Default retention for hosted customers is 90 days; enterprise plans can request custom retention and archival to S3 for e-discovery.

James K.: For Dedicated/Private customers: yes, request-level logs can be exported to customer-controlled S3 if they enable log export; we also have role-based filters so sensitive fields are redacted before export (configurable per-org).

Emi W.: A couple quick followups: 1) Can Dedicated customers bring their own HSM for key wrapping? 2) How will key rotation be handled for BYOK?

Ajay P.: Short answers: 1) BYO-HSM for Private/Dedicated is in the plan — expected pattern is a KMS proxy + HSM-backed key store; we'll ship connector examples. 2) Rotation: we'll provide a key-rotation API + re-encryption tooling; customers rotate keys in their KMS and can trigger a rewrap job from the console. Note: model checkpoints encrypted at rest will need a coordinated maintenance window for rewraps.

security-bot: Draft doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/byok-hsm-integration (internal draft). Ajay to publish public guidance once vendor contracts are finalized.

Sarah L.: Can someone drop a minimal IAM policy + CLI snippet for enabling log export to S3? That helps early adopters.

Ajay P.: Sure — minimal example policy (customer side):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-customer/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

And the CLI to enable export (example):

```bash
redwoodctl logs export enable --org my-org --dest s3://redwood-logs-customer --region us-west-2
```

Maria G.: Note: exports are atomic per-batch; if you need strictly sequential per-request logs for legal/compliance you should enable S3 + delivery-guarantee mode (will document caveats).

James K.: On evidence requests: Security will provide an evidence pack template and a runbook for compliance engagements. If you need data for legal/ediscovery, file a support ticket with the compliance tag and we'll coordinate the export/retention window.

Emi W.: Thanks — can someone add roadmap items for "HSM integration playbook" and "audit export runbook"? I'll own tracking and follow-ups.

Ajay P.: Done — added both items to the product board and assigned Emi. I'll post the board link tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

Sarah L.: Appreciate it. If anyone has more Qs drop them here or ping me directly. Closing the loop for folks who asked during the all-hands. :sparkles:
